title: MATH-SYNC v1.0: Reproducible Computational Pipeline for Robust and Identifiable Affine-Clock Alignment of Heterogeneous Multirate Sensor Streams
description: MATH-SYNC v1.0 is a reproducible computational pipeline for robust and identifiable affine-clock alignment of heterogeneous multirate sensor streams. The release includes controlled synthetic validation, semi-synthetic perturbation-and-replay using public Harvard timing schedules, within-participant session replication, participant-level Harvard replication, external schedule-replay replication using WESAD, participant-level statistical inference, manuscript-aligned Tables 1-4 and Figures 1-7, Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Figures S1-S4, automated tests, environment specifications, and SHA-256 integrity manifests. Raw Harvard and WESAD datasets are not redistributed.
